'''Melita Football Club''' is a Maltese professional [[association football|football]] club that represents the town of [[St. Julian's, Malta|St. Julian's]]. Melita was recently promoted to the Maltese top flight for the fifth time in their history, and will once again be playing in the [[Maltese Premier League]] from the 2024–25 season.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Maltese Football Association Website for Melita|url=https://www.mfa.com.mt/en/leagues/leagues/93/bov-amateur-league-c.htm?feature=teams&mp=192}}</ref> They also play in the annual [[Maltese FA Trophy]].<ref>{{Cite web|title="Maltese Football Association FA Trophy Round 2, 2018/19"|url=https://www.mfa.com.mt/en/cups-competitions/cupscompetitions/bycategory/1/publish_date/asc/0/1/the--fa-trophy.htm?round=3&s=11}}</ref>"}}
